تبتهجوا (form VIII)
# تَبْتَهِجُوا (tabtahijū) /tab.ta.hi.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# تُبْتَهَجُوا (tubtahajū) /tub.ta.ha.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
